artboards.title: Variant E — menu in the dock

annotations.text:
Round 2. The sidebar placement is out — measured: property rows are 61px and the sidebar scrolls as one column, so a Pivots tab falls below the fold at 13 properties.

D is the rail mode you asked for, built as a POINTER mode rather than a flyout — that is what gives it tools, a render slot for narrowing, and onEnter/onExit as the summarize boundary.

E is the other new one: the menu in the dock, where narrowing finally has width.

Ruled-out round 1 is on page 3.

D — Pivot as its own rail mode — RECOMMENDED

Its own tools: Pick origin / Lasso origin. Its own options: dim nodes with no pivots. Its own panel, full canvas height, indifferent to how many properties a node carries — the sidebar here has 18 and it changes nothing.

The argument that decided it: entering the mode IS the intent that fires summarize, and leaving it IS the disinterest that stops every call. D11 stops being a rule to enforce and becomes a property of the mode.

Two asks: the tool panel is 216px today and this wants 300px; and a full-height panel pushes the legend off the canvas's left edge (drawn here as the legend moving).

E — the menu in the dock, beside its own results

The only placement where narrowing is laid out ACROSS rather than down: 1,260px, four facets visible at once, nothing scrolled. Choose the pivot, narrow it, fetch, triage — all adjacent tabs in one region.

Costs: it needs the dock open (332px, 35% of the viewport) to do anything at all, it turns a surface framed as read-only reflection into an action surface, and it gives the canvas no part to play.

Keep it in reserve: if four facets in a 300px column prove too tight once real providers are wired, this is the fallback that already has the room.

Round 1, kept for the record.

A — a Pivots section inside the Select tool panel. Mode-scoped, so switching to Create to draw one edge discarded a narrowing session. D is this idea done properly.

B — a popover on the selection. Overlaps the dock by 168px at an ordinary anchor, re-anchors on every pan, fights the context menu, and has no anchor for 50 nodes.

C — a Pivots tab in the selection sidebar. Killed by measurement: 61px property rows, one scrolling column, below the fold at 13 properties.

Library gaps this design depends on:

1. An actionable toast — and not merely a button. Today's dies on a hard 4s timer with no handle, which is less time than it takes to read "Ingested 12 nodes, 14 edges". Without it, auto-ingest pivots have no undo surface at all.

2. DockTabHandle.setLabel(), or the candidate count stays in the pane header rather than the tab strip.

3. Dark tokens for the refusal amber and the success-toast green — the only two colours here that are not already in _variables.scss.

4. A per-mode tool-panel width: 216px is fixed today, Pivot mode wants 300px.
